system.description: After you hit an enemy with a ranged attack, spend 10 MP to deal no damage and delay it, choosing: the next time you or an ally hits that enemy, add (SL + delayed damage) bonus damage; or deal (SL + delayed damage) fire damage to it at the start of a chosen creature's turn; or deal that fire damage to it at the end of the round.
